title: NotOnlyHardcore
description: A Paper plugin that sends players to prison on death, adds cursed player heads, protects new players, and includes a configurable duel system.
body:
# DeathBan

A configurable Paper plugin that adds high-stakes survival mechanics to Minecraft.

## Features

* ⛓️ Prison system that automatically jails players after death
* ⏳ Configurable prison location and sentence duration
* 💀 Player heads drop on death and apply custom potion effects when used
* 🛡️ New player protection with configurable resistance effects
* ⚔️ Built-in duel system with dedicated arena support
* 🔧 Fully configurable through commands and config files
* 🔊 Customizable death sounds and effects
* 🔄 Live configuration reload support

## Commands

### Administration

* `/db unprison <player>` — Release a player from prison
* `/db reload` — Reload the plugin configuration

### Prison Settings

* `/db set prison <setting> <value>`

### Head Settings

* `/db set head <setting> <value>`

### Death Sound Settings

* `/db set deathsound <setting> <value>`

### New Player Protection

* `/db set protection <setting> <value>`

### Duel System

* `/db duel <player>` — Send a duel request
* `/db duel accept <player>` — Accept a duel request
* `/db duel deny <player>` — Deny a duel request
* `/db set duel ...` — Configure duel arenas and settings

## Requirements

* Paper 26.1.2
* Java 25

## Perfect For

* Hardcore-style survival servers
* Semi-anarchy servers
* SMP communities
* PvP-focused servers
* Competitive Minecraft experiences

Make death matter while giving players meaningful ways to fight back and challenge each other.
